title: OAuth Clients
description: Applications registered to authenticate against this MetaMCP server over OAuth 2.1.
adminOnly: Only administrators can manage OAuth clients.
noClientsDescription: Create one to connect an OAuth application such as a Claude connector.
createClientDescription: Register a new OAuth 2.1 client. Credentials are issued immediately.
redirectUrisHelp: One per line. Must use https (http is allowed outside production).
claudePresetApplied: Filled in the Claude connector callback URLs
authMethodHelp: "None" issues no client secret and relies on PKCE, which is the OAuth 2.1 recommendation for public clients.
secretWarning: Copy the client secret now. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.
publicClientNote: This is a public client using PKCE, so no client secret was issued. Enter only the Client ID in your application.
deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and revokes every authorization code and access token already issued to it. Applications using it will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
registeredFromHelp: The network address the self-registration came from. It does not identify a person and does not show that the client is safe.
clientApproved: Client approved. People can now authorize it; each person still approves their own access.
clientRejected: Client rejected. It cannot be used and is removed after a day.
decisionStale: This client changed since the list loaded, so the list was refreshed.
approvalExplanation: Applications on a person's own computer, such as Claude Code, can register themselves, but they stay "Waiting for approval" until an administrator approves them here. Only local (loopback) callbacks can be approved this way; hosted applications such as claude.ai use a client created with Create OAuth Client. Approving a client grants no access by itself: each person still approves their own sign-in. Approve only clients you recognize, and check the address they registered from.
